title: FancyZones exclude by pressing shift during drag no longer working

status.label: Clear FancyZones regression
status.detail: The report distinguishes pressing Shift before a drag from pressing it during a drag on the current release.

next_action.label: Design mid-drag exclusion fix
next_action.reason: The input sequence and regression boundary are specific enough for focused investigation.

actions.label: Design FancyZones Shift exclusion fix
actions.note: Trace modifier-state updates during an active window drag and define tests for Shift pressed before and after drag start. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The issue provides a current-version regression with a controlled comparison between two timing variants of the same modifier.
evidence: With hold-Shift-to-enable disabled, pressing Shift during an active Notepad drag no longer excludes the window from zoning.
Pressing Shift before starting the drag still excludes the window as expected.
The reporter states the issue was not present in the previous build and targets 0.101.2362.0.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate FancyZones modifier handling during active drags and design regression coverage for modifier changes after drag acquisition.
